value.expected: Local: the selftest alone, 17.7 s measured, well under its 300 s limit, 759 of 759 checks passed, no tool run, no package resolution, no network. On the rented box, if a launch is authorised: one run of at most 7,200 s of wall clock from the start of the bootstrap, stopping earlier when projected spend reaches the budget given (USD 5 or less, at most USD 4.31 of box time at USD 1.99 an hour), against a hard cap of USD 10 for the whole experiment, of which USD 0.30 is already spent. A complete run writes eight records through the provenance writer under results_m4/out/: one for the redocking anchor, one for each of the four inputs (prediction hours per run, dynamics nanoseconds per day, auxiliary hours per pair, storage gibibytes) and one for each of the three controls (the 60 s sleep, the empty run, the worked examples of unit and scale). Beside them: the pair evidence file and three sequence files, the rate-reporter files, the raw docking rank tables, the download and package report files, the environment file, the summary, the validity marker and the completion marker. Raw rows, one line of JSON each: 9 prediction runs (3 stand-in pairs by 3 seeds), 2 anchor dockings (serial, then parallel), 3 per-pair docking and analysis timings, 3 dynamics segments, and one storage measurement per artifact type. A run that stops early writes fewer rows and voids the inputs it could not measure; every record then carries the full incomplete-run label, and the same-box second docking is a repeat on one machine, never a replication.
